criteria.description: FilterContext.tsx calls useDebounce with a conditional delay: `search === '' ? 0 : 300`.
criteria.evidence: Line 51 of src/benchmark-frontend/src/context/FilterContext.tsx reads: `const debouncedSearch = useDebounce(search, search === '' ? 0 : 300);` — the conditional expression resolves to 0 when search is empty and 300 otherwise.

criteria.description: Typing into the search field does not update debouncedSearch until 300 ms after the last keystroke; rapid keypresses reset the timer.
criteria.evidence: tests/debounceSearch.test.tsx: all 5 tests passed including 'typing a search term eventually filters the product list' (419ms), 'search is case-insensitive' (361ms), 'search combines correctly with category filter' (338ms). Full run: 22 passed, 0 failed.

criteria.description: Clearing the search field causes debouncedSearch to become '' immediately with no 300 ms wait, and any pending debounce timeout must not fire after the clear.
criteria.evidence: tests/debounceSearch.test.tsx: all 5 tests passed (including 'clearing the search field restores all products' and 'clearing search while a category is active keeps the category filter'); none timed out. Total debounceSearch suite: 5 tests, 1240ms, all ✓.
